lab_questions.title: Minimum Escalation Hops for Support Ticket
lab_questions.description:
An enterprise support routing engine manages communication channels between N internal specialized teams (labeled 0 to N-1). When a customer opens a ticket, it starts at team S and must be transferred across team links until reaching target domain team T.

Read N (number of teams), M (number of bidirectional transfer channels), S (source team), and T (target team), followed by M pairs of team connections (u, v). Print the minimum number of transfers (hops) required to route the ticket from S to T, or -1 if T is unreachable from S.

tasks.title: Test Case 1
tasks.description:
Validate your code against test case 1.
Input:
5 5 0 4
0 1
0 2
1 3
2 3
3 4
Expected Output: 3

solution.python:
import sys
from collections import deque
data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
if data:
    n, m, s, t = data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3]
    adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
    idx = 4
    for _ in range(m):
        u, v = data[idx], data[idx+1]
        adj[u].append(v)
        adj[v].append(u)
        idx += 2
    dist = [-1] * n
    dist[s] = 0
    q = deque([s])
    while q:
        curr = q.popleft()
        if curr == t:
            break
        for nxt in adj[curr]:
            if dist[nxt] == -1:
                dist[nxt] = dist[curr] + 1
                q.append(nxt)
    print(dist[t])
